# An empty body creates a blank person record

**Claim.** Every field is optional, including the name, so `{}` is a valid payload on both create endpoints: create answers 201 Stored, and findOrCreate — with no criteria to match on — answers 201 UnmatchedStored. Each call leaves a nameless person record behind.

Applies to: `~1people~1create/post`, `~1people~1findOrCreate/post`

## Observed exchange

_Create from nothing._

```http
POST /people/create

{}

→ 201
  Location: https://api.securevan.com/v4/people/100000001
{
  "vanId": 100000001,
  "status": "Stored"
}
```

_findOrCreate from nothing: no criteria means no match, which means create._

```http
POST /people/findOrCreate

{}

→ 201
  Location: https://api.securevan.com/v4/people/100000002
{
  "vanId": 100000002,
  "status": "UnmatchedStored"
}
```
